feeds.title: The Viking Dragon Blog
feeds.description: Explore our latest stories and information about Norse Gods, Norse Mythology, Viking Products and their origins. 'The Viking Dragon' is the latest creation from 'The Jelling Dragon', which was founded in 1996 by Viking reenactor and Dark-Age Pagan enthusiast Rob Taylor (aka Ruald the Wad).

feeds.title: Just Another Norse Mythology's Blog
feeds.description: I am Logan, 21 years old. I've always been interested in Norse Mythology and Paganism, now I've decided to study them for real. Follow my articles for more information on norse mythology.

feeds.title: VKNG Jewelry Blog
feeds.description: Find out more about Vikings, mythology and Norse with our articles. V.K.N.G is a community of courageous/strong men and women who are proud of their cultural heritage. V.K.N.G is a French company with the mission of selling authentic, handcrafted, but affordable Nordic & Slavic jewelry and accessories, using only the highest quality materials. Craftsmen create unique and elegant bracelets, necklaces and rings, inspired by Viking culture and genuine Norse/Slavic symbolism.

feeds.title: Liam G. Martin | Norse Mythology Blog
feeds.description: I am Liam G. Martin, a children's writer from Nottinghamshire in the United Kingdom. This is my blog of Norse myth retellings. Stay a while and learn the secrets of the Gods.

feeds.title: Sons of Vikings Blog
feeds.description: We are a family-owned business based in Chesapeake, Virginia, USA. Our website offers over a thousand different items including replicas of original Viking jewelry artifacts, modern-day inspirations, reenactors and modern clothing options, Norse-related artwork, and more.

feeds.title: Vikings of Middle England Blog
feeds.description: -Vikings of Middle England's chief aim is to create an accurate historical representation of the Viking Age that is entertaining. Made up of volunteer members, and run as a non-profit organization, Vikings of Middle England provides spectacularly visceral combat set-pieces, dramatic scenarios, and an extensive encampment that breathes as craftsmen and women go about their business.

feeds.title: Viking Warrior Blog
feeds.description: Viking Warrior is an online store that sells authentic Viking clothing, jewelry, and accessories. They offer a wide variety of products, including tunics, pants, cloaks, belts, shields, helmets, jewelry, and more. They also have a selection of modern streetwear inspired by Viking culture.

feeds.title: Norse Tradesman Blog
feeds.description: Norse Tradesman is the product of imagination and dreams of simpler times. Founder Neil G grew up conjuring fantastic scenes of adventure, magic, and chivalry while exploring the dense forests of rural New England. Norse Tradesman's goal is to transport our patrons back to the enchanting times of our forefathers. Read our Viking blogs and find out astonishing history facts about the Norse culture, Norse Mythology and more!

feeds.title: The Norse Wind
feeds.description: Welcome to TheNorseWind - a place for handcrafted Norse mythological treasures - runes, amulets, talismans, and rune sets! Discover a stunning collection of authentic Viking jewelry at The Norse Wind. Handcrafted with care, our exquisite selection of necklaces, bracelets, and rings embodies the spirit of ancient Norse traditions. From intricately designed pieces to bold and powerful runes, our jewelry captures the allure of Viking culture.

feeds.title: The Old Norse Blog
feeds.description: Jules William Press is a small press devoted to publishing the best about the Viking Age, Old Norse, and the Atlantic and Northern European regions. Jules William Press was founded in 2013 to address the needs of modern students, teachers, and self-learners for accessible and affordable Old Norse texts.

feeds.title: Odin's Cave Blog » Viking History
feeds.description: As a small family run business, with a passion for true Nordic and Viking history and styles, we wanted to create something different, unique and modern, so we put pen to paper and Odin's Cave was born! Discover Viking jewelry and gifts online, shop necklaces, bracelets, earrings, rings, and accessories, embrace the Norse Viking spirit, and browse now!

feeds.title: Viking Archaeology Blog
feeds.description: The Viking Archaeology Blog is concerned with news reports featuring Viking period archaeology. It was primarily constructed as a source for the University of Oxford Online Course in Viking Archaeology: Vikings: Raiders, Traders and Settlers. For news reports for general European archaeology, go to The Archaeology of Europe News Blog.

feeds.title: The Norse Mythology Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Karl E. H. Seigfried is a writer on mythology and religion. He is an Adjunct Professor & Pagan Chaplain at Illinois Institute of Technology. This blog reflects into a deep knowledge of this ancient religion, along with an affable spirit.

feeds.title: Norse And Viking Ramblings
feeds.description: A gentle wanders through the Viking world. Here you will find his teachings and research into Old Norse language and literature and the Viking Age. The purpose of this blog is to record experiences and observations from his encounters with Vikings in the media, in popular culture, and on his travels in the Viking world.

feeds.title: Lulfolk » Vikings And Norse Mythology
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Philip and I'm a blacksmith based in Sweden, in a village close to Gävle called storvik. I make jewelry, tools and household items for everyday life, larp or reenactment. Explore my articles on Norse and Vikings mythology in this section.

feeds.title: Viking Store | Viking Blog
feeds.description: A historical compendium of documents on the Vikings & Norse mythology. You will discover the Norse gods, the Viking symbols and all the fascinating stories & facts. This is THE resource for anyone interested in Nordic Culture and its origins. VIKING STORE Positioned today as one of the world's largest suppliers of Nordic and Viking goods in terms of quality - price and authenticity. The jewels of Nordic and Viking myths, deciphered and remodelled into bracelets, necklaces, pendants, exceptional and steeped in history.

feeds.title: A Pilgrim In Narnia » Norse Mythology
feeds.description: 'A Pilgrim in Narnia' is a blog project in reading and talking about the work of C.S. Lewis and the worlds he touched, like children's literature, apologetics, myths and mythology, fantasy, theology, cultural critique, and writing, as well as the work of his fellow Inklings J.R.R. Tolkien and Charles Williams. Explore more about Norse mythology, gods and more!

feeds.title: Norse Spirit Blog
feeds.description: Hi and welcome to Norse Spirit! We are proud to be one of the foremost online retailers of quality Norse and Viking jewelry and accessories in the world. We have a huge range of Viking-inspired jewelry, most of which is shipped worldwide directly from our warehouse in New Jersey. Other items such as mugs, clothes and household items are printed to order offsite and dispatched directly from our fulfilment partners. Explore more on the mythological stories from Norse here.

feeds.title: Life in Norway » Viking
feeds.description: Life in Norway is an information guide for English speakers living and working in Norway, and for those who want to make the move. The website is written by foreigners from all around the world who are already settled in Norway, to give you the inside scoop on what life is really like here-from an outsider's perspective. Here on Life in Norway's Viking blog, we dive into the history, lifestyle, and culture to try to figure out what Viking life in Norway was really like.

feeds.title: Norhalla Blog
feeds.description: Norhalla, Inc. creates fun, illustrated children's books and toys from Norse mythology and Scandinavian & Nordic lore. Norse mythology is a fascinating collection of stories, gods and goddesses, and people from the Viking Age. The gods and goddesses from Norse mythology are some of the most famous figures in Viking history.

feeds.title: Odins-Glory Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Odin's Glory, a brand dedicated to bringing the rich history and heritage of the Vikings to life through stunning, high-quality jewelry. Our mission is to craft Viking jewelry that not only looks beautiful but also carries the powerful legacy of the Vikings. Each piece of jewelry is made with care and precision to ensure that it meets the high standards of quality and authenticity that our customers expect.

feeds.title: Runecast Copper Blog | Norse Mythology
feeds.description: Runecast Copper is a UK-based online retailer of handmade copper jewelry inspired by ancient cultures and mythologies. They offer a wide variety of products, including pendants, bracelets, rings, earrings, and more. Their jewelry is made from high-quality copper and is designed to last for years to come. Runecast Copper is a great place to find unique and stylish jewelry that is inspired by history and tradition.

feeds.title: Follow The Vikings Blog
feeds.description: Follow the Vikings is a four-year transnational project funded by Creative Europe, which aims to make transnational Viking heritage accessible and understandable to a worldwide audience. Follow the Vikings aims to build on previous work by the Destination Viking Association, maintaining and enhancing the Viking Cultural Route, developing the Destination Viking network, and, through networking activities, helping knowledge transfer and quality improvement at heritage sites throughout Europe.

feeds.title: Viking Front Blog
feeds.description: Prepare to immerse in Viking culture via hand-selected meticulously designed Viking jewelry, as well as our educational information about this fascinating era, most notably through our blogs.

feeds.title: Vikings Brand | Norse News
feeds.description: The Vikings Brand is led by two passionate heathens from the Reykjavík, Iceland, with the aim of giving a new life to the ancient Norse culture and symbols, by introducing them in the digital, modern World. Learn more about Norse mythology and Vikings history with our articles.

feeds.title: Norse Mythologist Blog
feeds.description: Norse mythology is a fascinating topic that is full of interesting stories and characters. If you want to learn more about Norse mythology, this is the perfect website for you. We will tell you all about the different gods and goddesses, as well as the heroes and heroines. You will also learn about the different types of creatures that populate the world of Norse mythology.
